correctness.rationale: All 27 generic lines have explicit integrally defined branches: fifteen R-sections and six copies of R[T]/(T^2+T-1), with exact cubic polarizations. Special nodal directions are a transverse conic-cubic intersection of six F5-points; away from the node, lines are rigid. The Fano scheme is a zero-dimensional relative lci on Gr(2,4) and hence finite flat of degree 27. Its six node-line tangents have dimension one, forcing length two at each by the total length. Normalized Pluecker p02/p01=T yields a surjection on every dual-number local ring and hence the full integral decomposition. The complete K6 incidence is proved by unique opposite-residue pairings and residual plane sections; the included verifier checks exact arithmetic and all F5 supports, but finite checks are not substitutes for this proof.

value.rationale: The exact flat degeneration of a natural Hilbert scheme of lines on a highly symmetric cubic surface explains how the classical 27 lines become 21 supports at the prime five, retaining six infinitesimal double points with explicit tame quadratic monodromy. The canonical K6 incidence records the geometry of the entire special fiber. These are motivated structural invariants not captured by mere point enumeration or by the already-known six node-line supports.
